# Yakup Gündüz

> Yakup Gündüz is a full-stack software developer in Istanbul and the founder of Harpos. He builds SaaS, web and automation systems with Next.js and Laravel, combining a C/C++ foundation with SQL optimization, RESTful APIs and Docker/Nginx deployment. He is open to remote work for other cities.

Name variants that refer to the same person: Yakup Gündüz, Yakup Gunduz.

Key facts:
- Location: Istanbul, Türkiye (open to remote work)
- Role: full-stack software developer
- Company: Harpos Teknoloji (founder and full-stack developer, August 2024 to August 2026, https://harpos.app): a multi-branch POS, billing and QR menu SaaS platform that served 5 cafés and restaurants
- Experience: Kle Bilgi Teknolojileri A.Ş., Yıldız Technical University Technopark (intern October 2023 to May 2024, software developer May 2024 to September 2024); Uniqh, London (data science specialist / developer, May 2024 to September 2024)
- Education: 42 İstanbul, Bilişim Vadisi (computer science, since June 2025); Istanbul University (graphic design, since 2024)
- Achievement: 3rd of 46 teams at Monad Blitz Istanbul with Inscribi Director (built the frontend and post-vote video visualization)
- Skills: Next.js, React, Laravel, JavaScript, HTML5, CSS3, C, C++; MSSQL, PostgreSQL, MySQL; CTEs, stored procedures, query optimization; RESTful APIs, microservice and monolithic architecture, OOP, SOLID, MVC, Repository Pattern, CQRS; Docker, Nginx, Git, GitHub, Postman; Claude, Codex, Antigravity, LLM integrations
- Languages: Turkish, English (B1)
- Contact: ykpgunduz@icloud.com
- Profiles: https://github.com/yakup-gunduz, https://www.linkedin.com/in/yakupgunduz
